calls_semantics: candidate dependency inventory; conditional execution is authoritative in references/call-graph.md and never bypasses the human review gate

entries.name: groundtruth-run-check
entries.trigger: A ground-truth case needs clean, warmup, and instrumentation preflight.
entries.validation: Run the declared preflight command and verify every mode predicate and output path.

entries.name: groundtruth-run
entries.trigger: A passed run check permits an isolated instrumented-vLLM ground-truth run.
entries.validation: Check exit code, fresh artifacts, mode predicates, and the recorded checkout tuple.

entries.name: simulator-run
entries.trigger: A frozen Frontier case is ready to run after semantic and mode checks.
entries.validation: Run the declared Frontier command and verify exit code, fresh metrics, and traces.

entries.name: semantic-alignment-check
entries.trigger: Frontier and vLLM values may look equal while their topology or runtime meaning differs.
entries.validation: Evaluate every registry row with source anchors and an explicit next action.

entries.name: semantic-alignment-repair
entries.trigger: A reviewed semantic alignment table names a concrete setting mismatch.
inputs: human review PASS or explicit auto receipt
entries.validation: Record approval before the code change, run an isolated check, then obtain fresh semantic evidence.

entries.name: e2e-metrics-gap
entries.trigger: Clean Frontier and vLLM request artifacts need independent latency and throughput gates.
entries.validation: Join each formal request once and calculate TTFT, TPOT, request E2E, request throughput, and token throughput.

entries.name: dispatch-align-trace
entries.trigger: Online client dispatch timing causes a visible arrival skew in the simulator trace.
entries.validation: Verify ids, token counts, priorities, finite offsets, and unchanged request payload before simulator replay.

entries.name: workflow-gap-analysis
entries.trigger: Request batches or timing paths differ and action, event, or behavior control flow must be explained.
entries.validation: Compare the first formal batch, all declared phases, available blocks, and workflow rows with source anchors.

entries.name: workflow-repair
entries.trigger: Reviewed workflow evidence identifies a reproducible Frontier control-flow difference.
inputs: human review PASS or explicit auto receipt
entries.validation: Apply the smallest Frontier code change, run isolated and clean checks, and refresh workflow evidence.

entries.name: op-gap-analysis
entries.trigger: Aligned scheduler batches and CUDA-op timings need a per-operator comparison.
inputs: raw scheduler, batch, and op traces
entries.validation: Normalize identity internally, require the first and three aligned batches, then calculate signed and absolute gaps.

entries.name: op-supplement
entries.trigger: Operator analysis lacks a formal batch, phase, shape, or profiling row.
entries.validation: Use the existing lossless merge tool, retain every base row, and record every added or deduplicated row.

entries.name: op-repair
entries.trigger: Reviewed operator evidence proves a scoped predictor, mapping, or profiling-input correction.
inputs: human review PASS or explicit auto receipt
entries.validation: Apply one scoped Frontier change, run focused and isolated checks, then regenerate op and E2E evidence.

entries.name: residual-lane-classification
entries.trigger: A residual remains after metric, workflow, and operator checks and needs a source classification.
entries.validation: Classify PP, collective, KV/M2N, mixed, or unclear residuals with native scope and numeric evidence.

entries.name: residual-repair
entries.trigger: Reviewed residual classification identifies a PP, collective, or KV/M2N correction.
inputs: human review PASS or explicit auto receipt
entries.validation: Select one declared lane, apply the smallest Frontier code change, rerun diagnostics, and refresh residual and E2E evidence.

entries.name: cpu-overhead-analysis
entries.trigger: Workflow and operator correction attempts are complete but a fresh clean E2E metric still exceeds ten percent.
entries.validation: Verify the shared CPU entry predicate and attribute host components without introducing an independent threshold.

entries.name: cpu-overhead-supplement
entries.trigger: CPU analysis reports missing identity tuples, phases, or replay/profile rows.
entries.validation: Retain every base row, label measured/replay/analytical rows, and return to CPU analysis.

entries.name: cpu-overhead-repair
entries.trigger: Reviewed CPU evidence proves a scoped Frontier host-side accounting correction.
inputs: human review PASS or explicit auto receipt
entries.validation: Apply one scoped Frontier code change, rerun CPU diagnostics and clean E2E, then refresh all applicable gates.

entries.name: parity-run
entries.trigger: A user needs one reproducible simulator and ground-truth case.
entries.validation: Call semantic-alignment-check, groundtruth-run-check, groundtruth-run, and simulator-run in order.

entries.name: error-analysis
entries.trigger: A completed case needs a read-only explanation of its numerical error source.
entries.validation: Run E2E, semantic, workflow, operator, residual, and conditional CPU analysis by explicit predicates.

entries.name: error-correction
entries.trigger: Reviewed analysis artifacts identify approved corrections that must be applied and rechecked.
inputs: human review PASS or explicit auto receipt
entries.validation: Run one approved domain code change at a time, obtain fresh analysis, and finish with the E2E gate.
